scene.value: An empty outdoor woodland theater dressing pavilion at blue hour. Preparing an original forest-fairy adult costume for a festival, she gives a small playful open-hand wave while her other hand rests separately on a low costume table. Warm round bulb lights and deep green curtains, no mirrors or other people.

outfit.value: Original forest-fairy event fashion: opaque structured lime satin sweetheart crop bodice with narrow straps and leaf-edged trim, a layered short cream chiffon skirt over fitted opaque shorts, small leaf earrings. Bare shoulders, arms and midriff; no wings, no armor, no weapons.

custom.value: One clearly adult woman in her 20s. Both hands fully within the chosen framing, each hand exactly one thumb and four individually separated fingers with coherent knuckles; no fused digits or extra fingers. No weapons, text, logo, border or duplicate figure.
